meta.title: BiletFlow — Event ticketing for Kazakhstan
meta.description: Create an event and issue QR-code tickets. Free events cost nothing; activate paid sales when you are ready.

home.headline: Your Next Great Event
home.subhead: Discover, book, and manage events across Kazakhstan. The smarter way to experience live entertainment.
home.organizerBody: Create an event and issue free tickets at no cost. Activate paid sales when you are ready to sell.

features.bookingBody: Reserve a ticket in under a minute. No queues.
features.qrBody: Your ticket lives on your phone, or print it for the door.
features.organizerBody: Sales analytics, attendee lists, promo campaigns, and check-in.
features.supportBody: Open a support case from any order or ticket and get a reply in the thread.

footer.tagline: Kazakhstan-focused self-service event ticketing. Create an event, issue tickets, check people in.
